映る/うつる.meaning: to be reflected, to appear (on screen)

対する/たいする.meaning: to face, to be directed toward

諮る/はかる.drop: rare formal verb (to refer to a committee); not an N3 word

討つ/うつ.drop: literary 'to strike down'; learners meet 打つ

片付く/かたづく.meaning: to be tidied up, to be settled

通じる/つうじる.meaning: to be understood, to lead to

ＯＵＴ/アウト.drop: written in full-width Latin letters; learners meet it as アウト

あら/あら.drop: kana alone: the fish-scraps sense is rare and the interjection is a different word

異/い.drop: rarely a word alone; used in compounds

意/い.drop: rarely a word alone; used in compounds

行けない/いけない.drop: written 行けない it reads as 'cannot go'; the 'bad, must not' sense is written いけない

市/いち.drop: learners read 市 alone as し (city); いち 'market' is rare

いや/いや.drop: kana alone: 'no!' and 嫌 'unpleasant' are both common

上/うわ.drop: a prefix; 上 alone is read うえ

柄/え.drop: learners read 柄 as がら (pattern); え 'handle' is rare

溺れる/おぼれる.meaning: to drown, to be addicted to

音/おん.drop: learners read 音 alone as おと; おん is in compounds

かかる/かかる.drop: kana alone: 'to take (time), to cost, to hang' are the common senses

角/かく.drop: learners read 角 alone as かど or つの

かく/かく.drop: kana alone: 書く 'write' and 'scratch' are both common

上/かみ.drop: rare sense; 上 alone is read うえ

観/かん.drop: a suffix, not a word alone

関/かん.drop: rarely a word alone; learners meet 関 in compounds

苦/く.drop: rarely a word alone; learners meet 苦しい, 苦い

酌む/くむ.drop: rare; learners meet くむ as 汲む

くわえる/くわえる.drop: kana alone: read as 加える 'to add', the common word

下/げ.drop: rarely a word alone; 下 alone is read した

吝嗇/ケチ.drop: rare kanji spelling; learners know けち in kana

後/ご.drop: 後 alone is read あと or うしろ; ご is a suffix

昨/さく.drop: a prefix, not a word alone

さす/さす.drop: kana alone: 指す, 差す (umbrella) and others are more common

凝と/じっと.drop: rare kanji spelling; learners know じっと in kana

下/しも.drop: rare sense; 下 alone is read した

小/しょう.drop: a prefix, not a word alone

上/じょう.drop: a suffix; 上 alone is read うえ

数/すう.drop: a prefix; 数 alone is read かず

性/せい.drop: alone ambiguous: sex, gender or nature

生/せい.drop: rarely a word alone; 生 alone is read なま

全/ぜん.drop: a prefix, not a word alone

相/そう.drop: rarely a word alone; used in compounds

大/だい.drop: a prefix; 大 alone is ambiguous (だい, おお)

たま/たま.drop: kana alone: 玉 'ball' and 'occasional' are both common

対/つい.drop: learners read 対 as たい; 'pair' is met in 一対

と/と.drop: a particle with many functions; not a card

棟/とう.drop: a counter for buildings; rarely a word alone

音/ね.drop: learners read 音 alone as おと; ね is literary

載る/のる.meaning: to appear (in print), to be placed on

はあ/はあ.drop: interjection with several senses (yes, huh?, sigh)

敗/はい.drop: a suffix (counting losses), not a word alone

放れる/はなれる.drop: rare spelling; learners know 離れる

分/ぶ.drop: 分 alone is ambiguous (ふん, ぶん, ぶ); the ぶ sense is rare

分/ぶん.drop: 分 alone is ambiguous (ふん minute, ぶん part)

番瀝青/ペンキ.drop: obscure kanji spelling; learners know ペンキ in katakana

方々/ほうぼう.drop: 方々 is also read かたがた 'people', a common sense

ほこり/ほこり.drop: kana alone: 埃 'dust' and 誇り 'pride' are both common

呆んやり/ぼんやり.drop: obscure kanji spelling; learners know ぼんやり in kana

間/ま.drop: 間 alone is usually read あいだ; ambiguous

まく/まく.drop: kana alone: 巻く, 撒く, 蒔く are all common

末/まつ.drop: 末 alone is read すえ; まつ is in compounds

まとまる/まとまる.meaning: to come together, to be settled

密/みつ.drop: rarely a word alone at this level

むく/むく.drop: kana alone: 向く 'face' and 剥く 'peel' are both common

訳/やく.drop: 訳 alone is read わけ (reason); やく is in compounds

優/ゆう.drop: a grade mark, rarely a word alone for learners

よる/よる.drop: kana alone: 夜, 寄る and 因る are all common
